title: The orange mod
description: A mod dedicated to the color Orange, for Dreamerc11's mod making series.
body:
A mod dedicated to the color Orange, for Dreamerc11's mod making series.

![➕This mod adds:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57445af9da0e55b52f5cb1d700172f11c7ef7245.jpeg)
1. New Ore And Blocks in the form of orangeium and topaz.![:orangium Ingot:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbd27b7021aead30d237bfb7e34aa0c2917fa026.png)
2. A new dimension: The Orange Land - In here everything is orange (even though it makes it a pain to find yourself).You can get here by making a neter portal out of orangium blocks
3. And a new pig that attacks you
4. Two new structures:
- The Tavern
- The Tower of Orange
  
- all with custom chests and lootboxes

![📋 DEVELOPERS NOTES](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b63f315e98c34c928475bb04fd12b63ee279a212.jpeg)

- This mod is currently still in development, And the mobs may not spawn.

- By Downloading this mod you can help with Its development by reporting bugs in @Dreamerc11's comments section on youtube.

Thank You For Downloading :)
